title: Native artifact targets the wrong CPU architecture
summary: A pre-existing AArch64 native addon layer has an ELF machine header different from the fixed Linux x64/glibc runtime, while a same-source x64 layer remains content-addressed for the intervention arm.

proof_eligibility.reason: The planned case changes one typed dimension inside the supported Linux isolation backend.

oracle.description: The unchanged fixture assertion exits zero and emits the DEV-NATIVE-002 success marker.

scenario.failure_mode: The loader hash-validates the selected addon, parses its ELF64 little-endian e_machine field as AArch64, and rejects it before require because that checked artifact does not match the fixed x64 runtime. A separate Host smoke records Node's real but generic cross-architecture dlopen failure without interpreting its text as an architecture proof.
planned_setup: Provide x64 and AArch64 content-addressed Linux addon layers compiled from the same source and Node 22 ABI headers.
Keep the Node ABI, source revision, compiler language level, loader assertion, and dependencies fixed.
Select the AArch64 layer in A1 and A2; select the x64 layer only in B.
Treat the binary ELF header as the architecture evidence and the direct Node loading failure only as a separate execution smoke.
